write_up: This is a common early-career resume: you have marketing, research and finance experience, but the marketing work is described mostly as duties. I read it for Marketing Intern roles. A recruiter would struggle to tell what you contributed at Badger State Credit Union.

The dairy farm research line is your model: it names the data, the tool and the study. Your headline claims manager-level campaign leadership that the jobs don't show, Education sits above Experience, and nothing accounts for the time after May 2024.

Let's start with the newsletter line, then add your part in social media and branch events. Replace the manager headline with a description grounded in your work, move Experience up, and account for the time since your last dated role honestly.
